title: States Interior (76-781)
text:
States Interior
OFFICE OF HEARINGS AND APPEALS
INTERIOR BOARD OF LAND APPEALS
4015 WILSON BOULEVARD
ARLINGTON. VIRGINIA 22203
DEC 8 1976
76-781 36120-TS75-25
COOS HEAD TIMBER COMPANY Timber Sale Contract
Vacated and Remanded
ORDER
Coos Head Timber Company appealed from the decision of July 1,
1976, by the Coos Bay, Oregon, District Office, Bureau of Land Manage
ment, which offered to reduce the contract purchase price of the subject
timber sale contract by $11,419.61 for wind damage to uncut timber.
Appellant contended that it had suffered damage in the amount of
$30,323.30.
The parties have since reached an agreement calling for an
adjustment of $20,364.00 in the purchase price instead of the
$11,419.61 originally offered by the Bureau of Land Management.
Accordingly, they have requested that the case be remanded to the
Bureau of Land Management so that the agreed upon adjustment may be
made to the contract.
Therefore, pursuant to the authority delegated to the Board of
Land Appeals by the Secretary of the Interior, 43 CFR 4.1, the dec
ision below is vacated and the case remanded to the Coos Bay District
Office, Bureau of Land Management, for the purpose of adjusting the
contract as agreed upon.
Martin Ritvo
Judge
We
Anne Poindexter Lewis
Judge
